query: I need exactly 1000 USDC out of a swap paid in XLM. Get me the quote and tell me how much XLM it costs with 0.5% slippage.
expected_behavior: Uses the server's reverse mode: one request with `amountOut` = "10000000000" (1000 USDC at 7 decimals) and no `amountIn`; never inverts a forward quote or a `rate` client-side to guess the input, and never sends both amounts (400: exactly one of amount_in / amount_out)

Resolves `from`/`to` to 56-char C… contract ids from GET /api/v1/tokens (`id`, `decimals`, `lp`) or addresses.md, never passing 'XLM'/'USDC' symbols or a Classic `CODE:GISSUER` string to /api/v1/quote
Passes `slippage` as the decimal 0.005, not 0.5 (the server rejects values outside [0,1) with 400 and 0.5 would mean 50%)

Reports the cost as the response `amountIn` (gross, fee-inclusive base units; `feeOnInput` says whether the fee sits on that side) and `amountInShort`, and explains that at the pinned server revision a reverse quote's `amountOutMin` stays at or above the requested 1000 USDC target even with slippage set, and checks that before building

Does not pass a `router` param, does not hardcode a router address, and re-quotes before execution because the quote carries no TTL and `snapshot.ledger`/`ageSeconds` only describe the search snapshot
machine_checkable: Generated TypeScript passes tsc --noEmit against @xoxno/sdk-js 1.0.214 and @stellar/stellar-sdk ^16
The quote request object contains `amountOut` and no `amountIn`, and no `router` key
Every `slippage` literal in the generated code is < 1
Quote `from`/`to` values are derived from the /api/v1/tokens response, with no 'XLM' or 'USDC' string passed as a quote param
